derivation:
by
  classical
  exact WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.map_baseChange (W' := (legendreWeierstrassCurve u v).toAffine) (FiniteField.frobeniusAlgHom F (AlgebraicClosure F)) P
explanation: Mathlib states that mapping a base-changed point along an algebra homomorphism preserves its base-change origin. Specialize to the Legendre curve and Frobenius on its algebraic closure. The library’s coordinate maps are definitionally the corresponding Mathlib point maps; no ellipticity assumption is required.
